output.summary: Deciduous tree native across a broad region of central and eastern Asia. It is often bushy, flowers before its leaves emerge, and releases wind-carried seeds. Its unripe seeds have long been eaten in Manchuria, while leaves were eaten raw or cooked with grain, notably during the Great Chinese Famine.
output.edibilityNote: Unripe seeds were long eaten in Manchuria and became important during the Great Chinese Famine; leaves were eaten raw or cooked with grain.
